question: The PM SVANidhi scheme launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs is for which of the following sections of the society?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Street vendors affected by COVID-19**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM SVANidhi** is an acronym that stands for** Prime Minister Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi.**
 
• It is a** public-sector initiative** that will be implemented in June 2020.
 
• Its goal is to give** microcredit to street sellers **afflicted by the COVID-19 outbreak.
 
• Initial operating capital of up to** Rs. 10,000 would be supplied to vendors.**
 
• A vendor will receive a 7% interest subsidy if the loan is repaid early or on schedule. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Prime Minister's Citizen Assistance and Relief in Emergency Situations Fund (PM CARES Fund) **should cover all orphaned children during COVID-19, not only those who became orphaned as a result of COVID.
 
• **'Garib Kalyan Rozgar Abhiyaan'** will be executed in 116 districts across six states in 125 days: Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, and Rajasthan, its an **employment scheme with an outlay of Rs 50,000 crore for migrant workers** who returned to their home states during the coronavirus-induced lockdown.
